TREG_PUBLIC_URL.description: Public URL this instance is reachable at. Auto-filled from the deployment's Railway domain (https://YOUR-DEPLOYMENT-DOMAIN) and used to build the GitHub OAuth callback — leave it as-is unless you put a custom domain / CNAME in front, in which case set it to that domain.

TREG_GITHUB_CLIENT_ID.description: GitHub OAuth App Client ID (recommended login door). Create at github.com/settings/developers. The callback URL to register is: https://YOUR-DEPLOYMENT-DOMAIN/auth/github/callback

TREG_GITHUB_CLIENT_SECRET.description: Secret for the GitHub OAuth app above. Required for the GitHub login door.

TREG_GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID.description: Google OAuth (web application) Client ID for Google sign-in. Register redirect URI https://YOUR-DEPLOYMENT-DOMAIN/auth/google/callback

TREG_GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET.description: Secret for the Google OAuth client above (pair with TREG_GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID)

TREG_RESEND_API_KEY.description: Optional — Resend API key for email OTP login. Requires a Resend-verified sending domain (SPF/DKIM).

TREG_EMAIL_FROM.description: Optional — From header for transactional email. Default: tools-registry <no-reply@treg.to>; set to your Resend-verified domain if you enable the email door.

TREG_FIXED_LOGIN_CODES.description: Optional — credential-free first login for one designated email. Format: email=hex (hex is the SHA-256 of a code you chose; comma-separate several). For that email the email-code door sends nothing and accepts only that code. Your escape hatch if no provider is configured yet.
